verification.note: Verified in arXiv:1507.03210 PDF text (Fig. 2 caption): 'We use MoSi SNSPDs with 70% detection efficiency at 1550 nm, at a temperature T < 2.5 K [27].' at_most 2500 mK matches the condition.

claim: Each of the four nanowire detectors (D1-D4) must be current-biased and read out electrically to record the 3- and 4-fold heralding coincidences.
quote: The amplification is heralded by a 3-fold coincidence given by a click in the detector D1, which heralds the input photon, followed by D2 and D3, heralding its teleportation.
document_title: Heralded amplification of photonic qubits (Bruno et al., arXiv:1507.03210, 2015)

verification.note: Fig. 2 caption quote verified verbatim. It describes D1-D3 heralding coincidences, which need current-biased, electrically read-out SNSPDs, so electrical.sample_connections present is a reasonable mandatory requirement. The quote supports it only indirectly.

claim: Optional: the detectors were designed for and operated in a two-stage closed-cycle cryocooler (no liquid-helium bath).

document_title: Heralded amplification of photonic qubits (Bruno et al., arXiv:1507.03210, 2015)

verification.note: Methods 'Detectors.' verified: 'The MoSi detectors were fabricated to obtain maximum efficiency at a wavelength of 1550 nm and for op-eration at 2.5 K in a two-stage closed-cycle cryocooler.' The sentence breaks across a column in the PDF. Optional cryogen_free=true is justified.

claim: The >90% system detection efficiency was obtained at 0.84 K; reaching that temperature is needed to reproduce the headline result.
